what: Income tax for 2026/27 (England, Wales and Northern Ireland) and the step from a pension pot to the pocket, worked by hand from the published rates. The app's own tax code is never used to make a row.

source.status: Rates and thresholds read from gov.uk on the date above (they are the same figures tests/oracles/incomeTax-2026-27.json carries); every row is arithmetic from them. The allowance-reduction rows follow HMRC's worked example: £1 off the allowance for every £2 over £100,000.
quoted: Basic rate £12,571 to £50,270 20%; Higher rate £50,271 to £125,140 40%; Additional rate over £125,140 45%
Your personal allowance goes down by £1 for every £2 that your adjusted net income is above £100,000
You can usually take up to 25% of the amount built up in any pension as a tax-free lump sum; the tax-free lump sums you can take are limited to £268,275

income.working: 37,700 at 20%: the top of the 20% band
7,540 + 49,730 at 40%: the last pound before the allowance shrinks
